card.name: Mixed spots in clinical warning text
card.fires_on: Strongest on the 'ry' inside 'dacryocystocele' and 'dacryostenosis'. Otherwise it fires on scattered small words in warning text, such as 'on' after 'based', 'because' after 'patients', or '(' after 'neutropenia'.
